s.t:
Seit über 25 Jahren entwickeln wir bei SEPPmail Secure-E-Mail-Lösungen, die Inhalte und Absenderidentität zuverlässig schützen und Spam sowie Malware in Schranken weisen – ohne technische Hürden für Absender oder Empfänger. Über 3.400 Endkunden aus Branchen wie Medizin, Energie, Finanz- und Versicherungswesen, öffentlicher Verwaltung, Pharma und Recht vertrauen auf unsere Technologie.

Mit Sitz in der Schweiz und Deutschland prägen Offenheit, Zuverlässigkeit und Wertschätzung unsere Zusammenarbeit im Team und mit unseren Kunden. SEPPmail ist Teil von LEA Partners, einem auf Softwareunternehmen spezialisierten PE-Unternehmen mit einem starken Netzwerk an Branchenexperten.
Zur Verstärkung unseres Produktteams suchen wir eine erfahrene, generalistisch denkende Persönlichkeit mit Leidenschaft für sauberen Code und moderne Entwicklungsmethoden.
Diese Stelle ist vollständig im Homeoffice zu besetzen - Du kannst von überall in Deutschland oder der Schweiz aus arbeiten.

The Sales Associate is responsible for providing all Marine Corps Exchange (MCX) customers with world class customer service with an additional emphasis on courtesy.

Sales associates are the primary service providers and will assist customers in every aspect of the retail business in a friendly, professional, and proactive manner that supports continued customer loyalty.

Sales associates assist their customers in challenging scenarios by using an ¿I can do that¿ mindset, to make all attempts for a positive customer experience and outcomes, before asking for support from the next level mentor or supervisor.

Sales associates are brand and customer program ambassadors for all Marine Corps and MCX programs, including but not limited to, Military Star, Super Star Student, customer satisfaction surveys and Keep it New.

This position can be scheduled throughout the facility, based on the needs of the business including but not limited to, cashier or self-checkout attendant, customer service, salesfloor / department support, stockroom / backroom, and military clothing.

In addition to working indoors, associates may be required to work outdoors or inside coolers and/or chillers. Limited time durations and proper Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) will be provided when working inside coolers and/or chillers.

Sales associates who are regularly scheduled in areas are expected to learn basic product knowledge to support customer satisfaction and service.

Sales associates perform store operations tasks such as but not limited to, customer and register transactions, Planogram revisions and setups, identifying missing products, replenish sales floor and coolers, setting promotional signage, visual merchandising, maintaining backroom standards through the 5S program and other operational tasks.

Light housekeeping tasks such as but not limited to sweeping, dusting and trash removal may be part of daily assigned duties. Sales associates are supported by the Specialist role with mentoring, guidance, and training. Sales associates are expected to work with, learn from and request guidance from Specialists in addition to their supervisors.

Sales associates utilize and complete tasks with basic retail equipment including, but not limited to, cash registers, time clocks, RF scanners, mobile printers, handheld equipment (i.e., Price labeling units, box cutters), signage equipment and basic fixture equipment such as, but not limited to peg hooks, shelves, and mobile stocking carts (5S Program).

Assists in preparing and participates in year-end inventory and preparation. Identifies and communicates potential risk of loss and/or theft. Sales associates market and train self-checkout to shoppers.

Maintain self-checkout units to include cleaning the units input and output belts, scanner glass, terminal display, magnetic card reader heads, and shutting down and rebooting as needed. Replace consumable supplies as needed. Charge mobile devices and device batteries as needed.

Sales associates understand how to perform functions from each of the following Self-Checkout application states: Shopping Mode, Store Mode, Assist Mode, Supervisor Mode, and Training Mode. Successfully interpret lane status indicators and clear all events identified by lane signals and lane status indicators.

May require additional training or certifications as required by the business and/or normal working assignments, including but not limited to, food safety training and fuel. Articulates MCX value stories and engages with all team members through positive conversations and driving customer satisfaction in a teams win environment.

Adheres to safety regulations and standards. Adheres to established standards of the EEO program and prevention of sexual harassment. Performs other duties as assigned. This is a mixed position where the associate must be able to lift and carry objects up to 45 lbs. independently and objects over 45 lbs. with assistance.
Minimum of 1-year experience working in a customer and sales-focused environment is preferred. Cash handling, basic math and register experience strongly preferred. Ability to read and understand operating standards and procedures for service, service recovery, sales and store brand and work within the position to execute these standards properly. Ability to work in a high-performance atmosphere with commitment to service and sales goals. Attention to detail is required.

QuickTeam helps US businesses grow by placing high-quality offshore talent — trained, vetted, and ready to work — at a fraction of the cost of hiring locally. We handle recruiting, onboarding, and client support from end to end. We're growing fast and looking for closers who want to be paid for what they actually produce. How this is different?

Most commission roles pay you once per deal and move on. This one keeps paying. Every month a client's virtual assistant is working, you earn. Close a client once, and that account generates income for as long as the VA stays — and our VAs typically stay for years. You're also not starting from scratch.

We have a dedicated lead specialist who continuously researches, qualifies, and contextualizes leads for you, so you're always working a warm pipeline. Your job is to close, not to build a list. What you get Warm, contextualized leads — a dedicated member of our team constantly builds and prepares your pipeline. You come in warm, not cold.

Recurring income — your commission is tied to hours billed by the VAs you place. Active placements mean monthly income, month after month, with no additional effort on your part. Long-term compounding upside — clients who stay for two or three years keep paying you the whole time. Your book of business grows and compounds.

Uncapped earnings in USD — no territory limits, no income ceiling. Full tools and access — CRM, dialer, email, and everything you need to work deals effectively. Backend handled for you — we manage recruiting, onboarding, and ongoing client delivery so you stay focused on selling.

What earnings look like Because commission is tied to hours worked rather than a flat placement fee, income compounds as your book grows. A modest base of a few active long-term clients generates meaningful recurring monthly income in USD — and that base keeps building as you close more.

The commission structure is competitive and discussed in full during the interview. How it works You apply and we walk you through the model, the leads, and the comp. We get you set up with tools and access. You start working leads and closing deals. You get paid — and keep getting paid every month your clients stay active.

Requirements What we're looking for Proven B2B sales or closing experience — staffing, services, SaaS, or similar preferred Exceptional spoken English is non-negotiable. This role is 100% phone-based selling to US business owners and decision makers.

Your voice, clarity, and confidence on a cold call is your product — if a prospect would hesitate for even a moment based on how you sound, this isn't the right fit. Candidates with a neutral, natural-sounding English accent are strongly preferred.

Comfortable working US EST/PST business hours Comfortable working leads by phone, email, and LinkedIn Self-motivated and disciplined — you don't need a manager over your shoulder Experience selling to or supporting US-based clients is a strong advantage Coachable, organized, and consistent in follow-up Hungry for uncapped, USD-denominated, performance-based income This role is not for Anyone expecting a base salary or guaranteed hourly pay People who need constant supervision or hand-holding Reps looking for a 9-to-5 with a predictable paycheck Originally posted on Himalayas

Databricks is seeking multiple Senior Lakebase Sales Specialists (Central) to help customers modernize their operational data foundation with Databricks Lakebase , our fully-managed Postgres offering for intelligent applications . This high-impact role sits within the Lakebase Go-To-Market team and partners closely with regional Account Executives to drive adoption of Lakebase with platform, application, and data teams.

Lakebase gives customers a unified, governed foundation for operational workloads and AI-native applications , helping them move away from a fragmented estate of point databases toward a modern, scalable, serverless Postgres service. If you want to be at the forefront of operational databases for AI and intelligent applications at one of the fastest-growing data and AI companies in the world, this is your opportunity.

This role is based in Munich, Germany (flexible within Germany for the right candidate), and will cover customers in the Central region (Germany, Switzerland, Austria, Eastern Europe).

The impact you will have

· Drive new Lakebase revenue by identifying, qualifying, and driving Lakebase activations and consumption within a defined territory, in partnership with regional Account Executives and the broader account team.

· Lead with outcomes for key Lakebase personas — including platform teams and developers , data teams , and central IT — articulating how Lakebase helps them ship features faster, simplify operational data architectures, and improve governance and cost efficiency.

· Sell the value of fully-managed Postgres for intelligent applications , positioning Lakebase as the optimal choice for operational workloads that power real-time, AI-driven experiences.

· Run complex, multi-threaded sales cycles from discovery and value hypothesis through commercial negotiation and close, navigating executive, technical, and line-of-business stakeholders.

· Orchestrate proof-of-value and POCs that validate Lakebase’s benefits for OLTP-style workloads, reverse ETL, and AI/ML-driven applications, in partnership with solution architects and specialists.

· Compete and win against legacy and cloud-native operational databases by leveraging our compete assets, benchmarks, and customer references.

· Align to measurable business outcomes such as performance, developer productivity, time-to-market for new features, cost reduction, and simplification of the operational data landscape.

· Partner cross-functionally with Product Management, Marketing, Customer Success, and Partner teams to shape territory plans, launch plays, and co-selling motions with key ISVs and GSIs.

· Enable the field by sharing Lakebase best practices, success stories, and sales motions with broader sales teams, helping scale Lakebase proficiency across the organization.

What success looks like in this role

This role requires the ability to operate across two key motions simultaneously:

· Establish top strategic focus accounts by engaging application development teams to create net-new intelligent applications leveraging Lakebase.

· Drive longer-term Postgres standardization and migration within Databricks' most strategic accounts.

Candidates should demonstrate how they can act as a force multiplier across multiple dimensions of the business.

s.h: Success in this role requires strength in four areas
s.t:
· Business ownership – Operate at a business-unit level by tracking revenue, pipeline, and key observations, and by identifying areas needing additional focus or support.

· Strategic account engagement – Partner with account teams to engage priority accounts across the global DB700, driving strategic opportunities from initial engagement through successful outcomes.

· Field, account, & customer enablement: Align customers and the field on the value of Lakebase by equipping AEs and SAs with the messaging and execution motions needed to confidently own accounts without specialist intervention.

· Market voice and thought leadership – Develop an internal and external presence by contributing to global AMAs and internal forums, and by representing Databricks at key first- and third-party events.

The interview process is designed to evaluate candidates across all four of these dimensions.

What we look for

· 8+ years of enterprise SaaS sales experience , consistently exceeding quota in complex, multi-stakeholder deals.

· Proven success selling data platforms, operational databases (e.g., Postgres, MySQL, cloud-native DBaaS), or adjacent data/AI infrastructure to technical buyers and business leaders.

· Strong understanding of modern data and application architectures , including cloud-native services, microservices, event-driven systems, and how operational data underpins AI and analytics strategies.

· Ability to sell to both technical stakeholders (developers, architects, data engineers) and business stakeholders (product leaders, operations, line-of-business owners).

· Demonstrated experience leading specialist or overlay motions , working jointly with core Account Executives to create and progress opportunities.

· Executive presence with the ability to whiteboard architectures , lead C-level conversations, and build trust with senior decision makers.

· Strong value selling skills: adept at discovering pain, building a business case, and tying technical capabilities to clear, quantified outcomes.

· Excellent communication, storytelling, and negotiation skills, with comfort presenting to both large and small audiences.

· Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.

· Experience selling Postgres, operational databases, OLTP workloads, or transactional cloud database services , ideally within large or strategic accounts.

· Familiarity with data platforms, lakehouse architectures, and cloud ecosystems (AWS, Azure, GCP), including how operational databases fit within broader data and AI strategies.

· Understanding of reverse ETL, real-time decisioning, and operational analytics use cases, and how they drive value for customer-facing and internal applications.

· Exposure to AI-native and agent-driven applications that depend on low-latency, highly scalable operational data services.

· Prior experience in a high-growth, category-creating environment , helping shape new plays, messaging, and customer narratives.

· Experience collaborating with partners and ISVs to drive joint pipeline and co-sell motions.

This description is intended to outline the core responsibilities and qualifications for the Lakebase Sales Specialist role. Actual responsibilities may evolve as the Lakebase product and go-to-market motions continue to grow and mature.

About Databricks

Databricks is the data and AI company. More than 10,000 organizations worldwide — including Comcast, Condé Nast, Grammarly, and over 50% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data Intelligence Platform to unify and democratize data, analytics and AI. Databricks is headquartered in San Francisco, with offices around the globe and was founded by the original creators of Lakehouse, Apache Spark™, Delta Lake and MLflow. To learn more, follow Databricks on Twitter , LinkedIn and Facebook .

We provide software solutions that address critical water data management, analytics, and compliance challenges for the rapidly growing water industry.

We offer a full range of solutions, from standalone software packages for individual users, hosted software services, and enterprise-wide national systems.

We serve over 1,000 municipal, federal, state/provincial, hydropower, mining, academic, and consulting organizations in over 60 countries that collect, manage, and process large volumes of water data.

BDRs serve as the front line of our go-to-market strategy , identifying potential customers, qualifying needs, and creating high-quality opportunities for Account Executives.
Why This Role?
This is an excellent opportunity for someone looking to grow their career in technology sales. You'll gain hands-on experience in prospecting, discovery, qualification, and territory management while making a direct impact on business growth.
If you're energized by outbound sales, enjoy building relationships, and want to grow your career with a purpose-driven technology company, we'd love to hear from you.

At Ecolab, we help make the world cleaner, safer and healthier .
Ecolab is a trusted partner at nearly three million customer locations in more than 170 countries and a global leader in water, hygiene and infection prevention solutions. We combine complete solutions, data‑driven insights and personalised service to help customers improve food safety, maintain safe environments, optimise water and energy use, and drive sustainable performance across food, healthcare, hospitality and industrial sectors.
If you are early in your career and looking to learn, grow and make a real impact, our Territory Manager in Training Programme could be the right next step.
About the Programme
This is a 12 month, structured development programme designed to prepare you for a future role as a Territory Manager. Starting from October 1st, 2026 you will be supported every step of the way through a combination of:
Classroom and virtual learning
On‑the‑job training and job shadowing
Coaching from experienced colleagues
Hands‑on experience with customers in real environments
From day one you’ll gain exposure to customer operations, learn how to diagnose challenges, and develop practical solutions that improve safety, hygiene and sustainability.
About the Division
Within the Water division (Nalco Water, an Ecolab company), Ecolab delivers water treatment, process and digital water management solutions to help customers improve operational performance, protect critical assets and advance sustainability goals. Our solutions support customers across industrial, manufacturing, food and beverage processing, power generation, energy, mining, data-centers and commercial facilities, from water intake through reuse and discharge.

After completing your training, you will take ownership of an established customer territory, becoming a trusted partner and technical advisor to your customers. You will provide expert guidance on water treatment, process optimisation and digital water management programs that help improve operational performance, protect critical assets and support safe, efficient and sustainable customer operations.

Build strong, trusted relationships with existing customers through regular service visits
Learn how customers’ systems work, gaining hands-on experience with equipment, technologies and solutions used in their daily operations
Support the installation, maintenance and safe use of equipment, helping customers keep their facilities fully operational
Train and support customer teams, making sure they feel confident using Ecolab solutions
Gradually develop the ability to spot improvement opportunities, deliver technical demonstrations and support the growth of your assigned territory
Work closely with colleagues across different teams (Sales, Marketing Services, Customer Service) to deliver the best possible customer experience
Contribute to Ecolab’s growth by supporting outreach activities and helping build our brand in your local market
What you’ll need?
We are interested in meeting individuals with diverse backgrounds. You may be a great fit if you:
Have completed technical / scientific education (Ideally in Chemical Engineering or Chemistry)
Are interested in building a career in technical, sales or service-related roles
Are eager to learn, open to feedback and motivated to continuously develop new skills
Have demonstrated problem solving skills and creative thinking
Are comfortable adapting to new situations and challenges
Have basic IT skills (Microsoft Office)
Have at least a B1 level in English
Hold a valid driver’s license, with an acceptable Motor Vehicle Record, and are open to traveling within your assigned district and occasionally nationwide
No Immigration Sponsorship available

In dieser vielseitigen Rolle bist du nahe am Verkauf, nahe an unseren Kundinnen und Kunden und ein wichtiger Dreh- und Angelpunkt im täglichen Geschäft. Du bist mittendrin im Verkaufsgeschehen und sorgst dafür, dass unsere Versicherungs- und Vorsorgeberatenden optimal unterstützt werden.
Mit deinem Organisationstalent erstellst du Offerten, verarbeitest Anträge und koordinierst Termine über alle Versicherungsbranchen hinweg. Gleichzeitig bringst du dein verkäuferisches Flair aktiv ein: Du erkennst Kundenbedürfnisse, denkst mit und trägst dazu bei, dass aus Kontakten überzeugende Lösungen entstehen.

* Eine abgeschlossene kaufmännische Ausbildung, ergänzt durch den Versicherungsvermittler VBV oder den Versicherungsfachmann/-frau mit eidg. Fachausweis

About Toptal
Toptal is a global network of top talent in business, design, and technology that enables companies to scale their teams, on-demand. With $200+ million in annual revenue and team members based around the globe , Toptal is the world’s largest fully remote workforce.
We take the best elements of virtual teams and combine them with a support structure that encourages innovation, social interaction, and fun. We see no borders, move at a fast pace, and are never afraid to break the mold.

As an Enterprise Sales Executive at Toptal , you will be a key driver of growth within our Healthcare and Life Sciences (HLS) industry vertical.

In this role, you will identify, develop, and close opportunities with enterprise provider, payer and life sciences clients by helping them solve complex business challenges across a broad range of capabilities, including technology, marketing, management consulting, and AI-enabled transformation.

You will develop tailored solutions that help clients accelerate strategic initiatives and achieve measurable business outcomes.
This role is designed for true hunters who thrive in a high-performance, client-facing environment. It is ideal for individuals who are passionate about building a book of business from the ground up, forging executive relationships, and creating long-term client value. Success in this role is measured by your ability to convert new enterprise relationships into durable revenue and to establish Toptal as a core services provider embedded in your clients’ critical initiatives.
This is a remote position with concentrated field work across the US. We do not offer visa sponsorship or assistance. Applicants must be authorized to work in the US at the time of hire. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English.

Healthcare and Life Sciences organizations are transforming due to regulatory changes, and pressure to perform far outpacing their current abilities. AI has shifted from experimentation to execution, and companies across this sector are actively rebuilding how work gets done, across therapeutic development, care delivery and healthcare financing. Toptal ’s Healthcare and Life Sciences (HLS) vertical already partners with some of the largest organizations in the world on exactly this work.
This role exists to bring expanded coverage to the US, where our client concentration and opportunity density are highest, and to convert that density into new enterprise relationships. You will report directly to the General Manager of the Healthcare and Life Sciences (HLS) industry vertical.

The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills.
You will be responsible for building a targeted portfolio of accounts via identifying, prioritizing, and developing your own book of business rather than inheriting an existing one. Once you have signed net new customers, you will partner with Client Partners to deepen and expand those strategic relationships over time.

Net new accounts typically involve mid-level stakeholders across one or two business units and call for a disciplined, transactional approach, matching skills to immediate needs with speed and precision. As relationships mature, accounts become more complex, with deeper engagement across multiple business units and senior executive relationships.

These accounts demand a highly consultative, strategic approach that includes navigating cross-functional priorities, aligning to evolving client business objectives, and demonstrating credibility at the C-suite level.

Success will require the ability to adapt your engagement style to the maturity and complexity of each account, while consistently driving value and long-term growth.
Own and build a portfolio of enterprise Healthcare and Life Sciences (HLS) accounts, with direct accountability for new logo acquisition, revenue growth, and client outcomes.
Prospect, pitch, negotiate, and close new opportunities in close partnership with our Sales Development Representatives (SDRs), while expanding the relationships you establish.
Define and execute account strategy, including opportunity creation, pipeline development, and multi-year growth planning.
Lead solution development and deal execution in partnership with Industry GMs, Practice Leaders, Pursuits, and Delivery teams.
Partner with Client Partners to drive coordinated account expansion and maximize total account value as accounts mature.
Shape industry solutions that apply Toptal ’s technology, marketing, consulting, and AI capabilities to the operating model challenges facing healthcare and life sciences organizations.
Maintain disciplined pipeline and account intelligence to support accurate forecasting and informed decision-making.
Lead strategic conversations with prospective and existing clients, while exercising discretion and independent judgment.
Your portfolio will ramp over your first 9-12 months, after which you will be measured against an annualized gross sales target of $3.5M, aligning with our broader portfolio strategies.

s.h: In the first week, expect to
s.t:
Onboard with Toptal and meet your TopPal.
Learn the core of Toptal ’s model, our value proposition, and our deep capabilities.
Familiarize yourself with the tools and resources needed to be successful.
Dive into our sales methods, our selling processes, and playbooks.
Become familiar with our contracting and legal methodologies, templates, tools, and processes.

s.h: In the first month, expect to
s.t:
Meet key Toptal stakeholders who will support your success and the success of the overall team.
Learn about the Industry Go-To-Market Strategy, our key sales plays, and our client engagement model.
Work with the Healthcare and Life Sciences (HLS) General Manager to establish a portfolio strategy and build account plans.
Shadow key calls and client meetings.
Begin to meet with clients, leveraging your existing industry network and relationships, to articulate Toptal ’s capabilities and identify where we can help organizations.
Begin prospecting and actively engaging target accounts within your portfolio.
Meet with SDRs, Client Partners, and cross-functional team members to align on joint account strategies.
Collaborate with Pursuits and Delivery teams to understand how we design engagements.

s.h: In the first three months, expect to
s.t:
Exercise discretion and independent judgment in the negotiation of contracts, work collaboratively with clients, and help them engage with Toptal ’s capabilities and specialists.
Begin shaping industry solutions that resonate with your target accounts, including AI-enabled approaches, demonstrating your comfort and ability in working with ambiguity and directly working to innovate alongside your clients.
Establish credibility with client stakeholders through informed, consultative engagement tied to their priorities and current initiatives.
Own your pipeline and forecast with confidence.
Develop proposals and close your first set of deals.
Actively contribute to team rituals, best practice sharing, and win/loss reviews.

Claroty is seeking a driven, curious, and resilient SDR to help accelerate pipeline generation and support our continued growth across the APJ region. In this role, you will serve as a critical bridge between Marketing and Sales, identifying and engaging prospective customers across industrial, healthcare, commercial, and public sector organizations.
You will be responsible for outbound prospecting, qualifying opportunities, and building trusted relationships with key stakeholders. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced, high-growth cybersecurity environment, enjoys proactive outreach, and is motivated by measurable business impact and career growth in enterprise technology sales.

Menschen beim Wohlfühlen helfen, ihnen die Auswahl erleichtern und natürlich IKEA Produkte verkaufen. Klingt gut? Klingt, als ob du weiterlesen solltest.

Bei Hager erweitern wir unser Geschäftsfeld im Bereich Smart Building, Gebäudeautomation und Energiemanagement im Projektgeschäft \- und du übernimmst dabei eine zentrale Rolle.
Dich erwartet ein Umfeld mit viel Gestaltungsspielraum sowie die Möglichkeit, ein strategisch wichtiges Thema für Hager Schweiz aktiv mit zu entwickeln.
Die Position ist im der Grossregion Zürich zu besetzen, und deine Tätigkeit erfolgt im Rahmen eines unbefristeten Arbeitsvertrages. Idealerweise liegt dein Wohnort im Raum Aargau.

· Neukundenakquise \& Marktentwicklung:
Aufbau und Entwicklung eines neuen Kundenstamms im Projektgeschäft (Elektroplaner, Systemintegratoren, spezialisierte Installateure)

Platzierung von Hager Systemen in Ausschreibungen inklusive Erstellung von Leistungsverzeichnissen, Konzepten und Angeboten

Entwicklung von Integrationslösungen für Gebäudeautomation, Energiemonitoring und BMS\-Anbindungen

Aufbau und Pflege eines regionalen Partnernetzwerks, insbesondere im Bereich Systemintegratoren
· Technische Unterstützung:
Beratung und Unterstützung von Planern und Integratoren bei komplexen Applikationen und Systemfragen
· Schulungen \& Präsentationen:
Durchführung von Workshops und Produkttrainings (z.B. KNX Secure, Energiemonitoring)
· CRM\- \& Pipeline\-Management:
Strukturierte Dokumentation von Projekten, Verkaufschancen und Kundenaktivitäten
Dein Profil

Elektrotechnische Berufsausbildung (EFZ) sowie Weiterbildung HF/FH in Gebäudeautomation, Elektrotechnik oder Smart Building

Zertifizierte KNX\-Ausbildung (zwingend) sowie mindestens 3\-5 Jahre praktische Erfahrung im KNX\-Umfeld

Fundierte Kenntnisse im Energiemonitoring (z.B. Wandler\- und Zählertechnik) sowie Erfahrung mit Modbus, BACnet oder DALI/DALI 2 und deren Integration in BMS

Professionelles Auftreten sowie ausgeprägte Kommunikations\- und Verhandlungsstärke im B2B\-Umfeld

Fähigkeit, komplexe technische Lösungen verständlich und überzeugend darzustellen (online und vor Ort)

Hohe Serviceorientierung und Freude an nachhaltiger Kundenbetreuung

Hohe Eigeninitiative, strukturierte Arbeitsweise und Motivation, ein wachsendes Geschäftsfeld aktiv mitzugestalten

adesso représente l'excellence en informatique, l'excellence en IA et donc aussi d'excellentes opportunités de développement pour tous les adessi. Nous grandissons ensemble et apprenons les uns des autres - à travers nos projets, en équipe et grâce à des formations exceptionnelles.

Nous avons l'informatique dans le cœur, le secteur en vue, le succès de nos clients à l'esprit et l'avenir avec l'IA à l'œil. Car une entreprise prospère naît d'idées innovantes, de stratégies durables et de solutions informatiques intelligentes déjà compatibles avec l'IA aujourd'hui.

Des personnes impliquées veulent faire bouger les choses et le font simplement. Nous concevons et développons des logiciels qui enthousiasment nos clients. Dans des projets qui nous challengent. Et cela dans un environnement qui nous plaît, où le succès se crée ensemble et où chacun se sent bien.

s.h: ## VOTRE RÔLE - CE QUI VOUS ATTEND ##
s.t:
* **Direction d'équipe :** Vous dirigez une équipe d'ingénierie de test, la développez continuellement et favorisez la collaboration. Vous coordonnez les missions de projet de vos membres d'équipe.
* **Gestion du personnel :** Vous vous occupez du recrutement, du développement et de la fidélisation des collaborateurs.
* **Développement :** Vous faites avancer les stratégies de test internes d'adesso sur des sujets actuels tels que l'automatisation des tests, les tests assistés par IA ou les technologies cloud.
* **Veille du marché et analyse des tendances :** Vous observez le marché et les tendances actuelles et développez des idées pour des innovations produits.
* **Relations clients :** Vous développez continuellement votre réseau client, êtes l'interlocuteur direct de nos clients et êtes opérationnellement impliqué dans les projets. Vous conseillez les clients de manière stratégique et méthodologique sur toutes les questions liées aux tests.
* **Travail de projet :** Selon votre profil, vous apportez votre expertise en tant que test manager, automatisateur de tests, analyste métier (BA), product owner (PO) ou ingénieur des exigences (RE) et assumez des rôles de leadership dans les projets chez le client.
* **Conseil stratégique et méthodologique :** L'optimisation des processus métier ainsi que la conception et la mise en œuvre de solutions informatiques sont au cœur de votre activité.

s.h: ## VOS COMPÉTENCES - CE QUE VOUS APPORTER ##
s.t:
**Consultant IT senior / manager avec affinité pour les tests**
* **Diplôme achevé** en informatique (économique) ou formation IT comparable ou expérience professionnelle IT
* **Expérience significative** en tant qu'analyste métier, product owner ou ingénieur des exigences dans des projets IT
* **Intérêt marqué et affinité** pour les tests et l'assurance qualité - des connaissances en automatisation des tests sont un plus mais pas obligatoires
* **Disponibilité et flexibilité** pour être déployé chez le client selon les besoins en tant que BA, PO ou RE
**Ce que vous apportez indépendamment du profil**
* **Expérience :** Bonnes capacités conceptuelles et analytiques ainsi qu'une forte communication et une compréhension rapide. Votre attitude est convaincante et assurée.
* **Qualités de leadership :** Vous avez une première expérience de gestion ou souhaitez évoluer vers un rôle de leader et construire et développer une équipe.
* **Communication :** Vous appréciez l'échange constant avec toutes les parties prenantes, êtes socialement compétent et communiquez de manière assurée et adaptée au public.
* **Compétences linguistiques :** Vous parlez très bien l'allemand (C1) et couramment l'anglais (B2) et êtes prêt à voyager.

s.h: ## DONNEUR D'OPPORTUNITÉS - CE QUI FAIT ADESSO ##
s.t:
Notre promesse : vous vous sentirez bien chez nous ! Collégial, communautaire et sur un pied d'égalité - nous vivons l'échange, l'esprit d'équipe et un respect mutuel. La diversité et les différents points de vue sont aussi appréciés chez nous que vous en tant que personne. Cela et bien plus encore représentent notre sentiment d'appartenance très particulier. Pour lequel il existe même un mot : adessi.
* **Apprenez et grandissez avec nous :** Avec plus de 400 offres de formation et notre plateforme d'apprentissage numérique, nous soutenons votre développement continu.
* **Vivez un véritable esprit d'équipe :** Des événements communs (par exemple, week-end ski et le voyage annuel de formation eduCamp), des journées d'accueil, des courses d'entreprise renforcent notre cohésion et vous permettent de faire partie de l'équipe dès le début.
Un engagement récompensé : votre investissement porte ses fruits - avec des primes pour les recommandations, les conférences, l'encadrement des travaux de fin d'études ainsi que des réductions attractives via notre portail Corporate Benefits.

Notre culture et notre collaboration sont marquées par la reconnaissance, l'appréciation et le soutien mutuels. Cela nous unit - même en télétravail. Le travail à temps partiel est possible sur accord (80-100%). Nous avons été à plusieurs reprises élus parmi les meilleurs employeurs de Suisse !

Notre large offre de formation et un modèle transparent de progression de carrière pour tous garantissent que votre développement ne stagne pas chez nous. Car grandir ensemble et être donneur d'opportunités, c'est inscrit dans notre ADN.

About Nivoda 🚀
Nivoda is a rapidly scaling global B2B diamond and gemstone marketplace connecting jewellery retailers with competitive, high-quality suppliers worldwide. Processing $300M+ in annual transactions and operating across multiple regions, Nivoda is transforming a $350B industry that has historically been slow to modernise.
Our platform gives businesses of all sizes, from independent jewellers to major retail chains access to the world's best diamond and gemstone inventory, without the traditional barriers of capital, geography, or information asymmetry.

Diamond and gemstone trading has long been plagued by inefficiency, opacity, and exclusivity. Nivoda was built to change that - to democratise access and empower every business, regardless of size or location, to buy and sell with confidence. Independent jewellers are at the heart of this mission. They deserve the same access to quality, pricing, and selection as the biggest players in the industry. That's exactly what we give them.

Our Sales team is the engine that brings Nivoda's mission to life. We're a high-energy, globally distributed group that moves fast, owns outcomes, and genuinely cares about the success of every jewellery business we work with. This is a team that thrives on commercial creativity, deep customer relationships, and relentless execution and we're growing fast.

You are the front of the machine: you take inbound leads and hunt outbound prospects, qualify them fast, and get a demo on the AE's calendar. Your job ends when the demo is booked and confirmed — everything before that moment is yours.
This is a high-velocity, transactional sales role. Think SaaS SDR playbook: tight cadences, high activity volume, sharp qualification, relentless follow-up. You will run multichannel sequences (phone, email, WhatsApp, LinkedIn), work a CRM with discipline, and be measured weekly on activity and demos held.
What will you be doing? 😎
Work inbound leads within SLA (minutes, not hours) and convert them to booked demos.
Build and execute outbound sequences against target retailer lists; personalise at speed, not at leisure.
Qualify hard: right buyer type, purchase volume, intent, timeline. Kill bad leads quickly.
Book, confirm, and protect the demo — reduce no-shows with reminders and pre-demo touches.
Keep the CRM immaculate: every touch logged, every lead dispositioned, pipeline data trustworthy.
Feed learnings back: objections heard, messaging that lands, segments that convert.
What do we need from you? 💪
1–3 years in a SaaS or tech-sales SDR/BDR role with a transactional, high-volume motion — short cycles, big numbers, daily intensity.
A killer on the phone and crisp in writing; comfortable with 60–80+ meaningful touches a day.
Process-driven: you live in cadences and CRM hygiene rather than fighting them.
Coachable and resilient — you treat "no" as data and keep the energy up on day 20 of the month, not just day 1.
Native or professional proficiency in English.
Jewellery knowledge not required; hunger and rigour are.

Younergy Solar ist ein Unternehmen für erneuerbare Energien, das Photovoltaik\- und Energielösungen für Unternehmen, öffentliche Institutionen und Privatkunden in der ganzen Schweiz entwickelt und realisiert. Unser Ziel ist nicht, nur über die Energiewende zu sprechen. Wir setzen sie um – Projekt für Projekt, Dach für Dach.
Zur Verstärkung unseres Wachstums in der Deutschschweiz suchen wir eine erfahrene Vertriebspersönlichkeit mit nachweisbarem Leistungsausweis im B2B\-Verkauf. \- Du trägst mit eigenen Ideen dazu bei, Prozesse, Angebote und Verkaufstools laufend zu verbessern
\- Du vertrittst Younergy an Messen, Ausstellungen und Fachveranstaltungen in der Deutschschweiz
